actives.name: Bolt
actives.text: Crossbow 100%; with a Lens it never misses.

actives.name: Shrapnel Mine
actives.text: Powder and Plate: a mine among the foes that bursts on the next of them to act, hitting the 3x3 around it.

actives.name: Turret
actives.text: Gear and Core: a construct that follows every ally's physical hit on a Marked target at 50%, for 300 ticks.

actives.name: Shield Drone
actives.text: Plate and Wire: a construct that keeps a 15% Shield on the weakest ally, recharging every 150 CT.

actives.name: Smoke Canister
actives.text: Vial: allies in the burst are Hidden for 100 ticks.

actives.name: Tonic Sprayer
actives.text: Vial and Spring: heal 0.8× to the cross and cure Poison.

actives.name: Grapple Line
actives.text: Wire: pull an enemy one column closer, into melee reach.

actives.name: Overclock
actives.text: Core: an ally gains 30 CT now, and their next charge is instant.

actives.name: Flashbang
actives.text: Powder and Lens: Blind and 20 Readiness damage to the band.

actives.name: Repair
actives.text: Gear: restore 30% Durability on an ally's worst location, or 40% of a construct's HP.

actives.name: Jury-Rig
actives.text: Any three Components become a random magic consumable: an Ether, a lobbed flask, an edge oil, a Scroll…

passives.name: Field Engineer
passives.text: Constructs have +50% HP and act 10 CT sooner.

passives.name: Pack Rat
passives.text: Start each battle with one Component from the last.
